user.title: Add a local TP-Link device
user.description: Connect directly to a supported TP-Link/Kasa/Tapo device. TP-Link Local does not request account credentials or use TP-Link cloud APIs.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device locally.
error.unsupported_device: This device does not yet expose a supported local-only transport in this build.

abort.dl100_ble_required: DL100 was identified, but its Wi-Fi DLKLAP transport requires cloud authentication. TP-Link Local will not use that path. DL100 support is being implemented through its Bluetooth Local Mode instead.
